title: Functorial bounded derived-tensor Tor spectral sequence
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $C,D\in D^b(R)$, the bounded subcategory [def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories] of the cochain derived category of $R$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the ordinary K-flat derived tensor $C\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}D$ of [lem-pc-derived-tensor-second-factor-functor] with $A=R$, and the Tor groups of [def-weil-pbc-tor-modules], extended by zero in negative homological degrees. There is a cohomological spectral sequence $E_s^{p,q}(C,D)$, $s\ge2$, in $R$-modules [def-sp-spectral-sequence], with
$$E_2^{p,q}(C,D)=\bigoplus_{i+j=q}\operatorname{Tor}_{-p}^R(H^i(C),H^j(D)),\qquad d_s:E_s^{p,q}\longrightarrow E_s^{p+s,q-s+1}.$$
For every integer $n$ it converges with a finite decreasing filtration $F^pH^n(C\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}D)$ [def-sp-filtration] and canonical identifications
$$F^pH^n/F^{p+1}H^n\cong E_\infty^{p,n-p}.$$
Here $E_\infty^{p,q}$ is the stationary value of the pages at $(p,q)$. The spectral sequence, the abutment filtration and these identifications are functorial in both derived-category arguments: morphisms $u:C\to C'$ and $v:D\to D'$ induce compatible page maps, on $E_2$ the direct sums of $\operatorname{Tor}_{-p}^R(H^i(u),H^j(v))$, and on the abutment $H^n(u\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}v)$, preserving $F^p$. No finite generation or finite global dimension of $R$ is assumed.
